title: Make global navigation identifiable and keyboard accessible
description: The authenticated shell menu button has no accessible name or expanded-state association. The navigation precedes more than twenty destinations without a skip-to-content link.
expected_behavior: Expose a meaningful menu name and current expansion state, provide a keyboard shortcut through a visible-on-focus skip link, and verify phone drawer dismissal and focus return without changing account permissions.
context: MainLayout.razor renders MudIconButton without Label, aria-label or aria-expanded. The deployed accessibility tree exposes an unnamed button; no focus-trap failure is claimed.

title: Provide page headings and route focus for Habits and Dailies
description: The Habits and Dailies routes render the page titles as level-two headings and contain no level-one page heading. The shared shell heading precedes the content in the heading outline.
expected_behavior: Each route exposes one descriptive page-level heading and receives useful focus after navigation. Category tabs and immediate capture remain available.
context: TodoHabitsPage.razor and TodoDailiesPage.razor delegate the visible title to TodoTaskPanel. TodoCategoryPageTests cover the route and actions without asserting the page-level heading.

title: Use consistent canonical task destinations from planning views
description: Inbox and Planning Add task links lead to /tasks, while Today Add task leads to /todo/tasks. History and Statistics also return to the mixed legacy /tasks surface, which shows both Companion capture and separate Habitica records.
expected_behavior: Ordinary Companion capture and return links use the canonical task surface consistently. Intentional links to the separate Habitica cache remain explicitly named and retain separate identity and reward semantics.
context: TodoPlanningPanel.razor, TodoHistoryPanel.razor and TodoStatisticsPanel.razor hardcode /tasks. The /tasks route still contains a Companion editor, so the issue is context and navigation consistency rather than missing capture functionality.

title: Explain workspace readiness and disabled editor recovery
description: The reviewed session initially shows Restoring Workspace, then Browser Workspace revision 1 with disabled task, project, saved-list and refresh controls. Generic correspondence text does not identify the actual condition preventing editing. Settings separately reports unverified existing server access.
expected_behavior: Show the observed source, loading or terminal unavailable state and precise read-only reason together with one relevant recovery action. Preserve browser recovery copies, original pending commands and independent consent; never silently select a different cloud source or enable execution.
context: TodoWorkspacePresentation combines coordinator availability, command read-only state and organization fences. Process Pending must establish the exact cause of the observed disabled state before selecting a behavioral fix; no data loss or automatic fallback is established.

title: Put daily work before optional reminder setup on Today
description: Today places a full reminder explanation and repeated workspace correspondence text before the task groups. In the populated synthetic phone state, the first task starts several screens below the date controls; enlarged text increases the distance substantially.
expected_behavior: Keep the selected day and daily task groups easy to reach. Present optional reminder setup and detailed source explanations through concise summaries or disclosures, while retaining urgent readiness, pending-command and unknown-outcome notices.
context: TodoTodayPanel renders TodoReminderPanel before todo-today-groups. The current 360-pixel synthetic capture places the first task near document y=1300 at normal text and y=5442 at 200-percent text, including the synthetic evidence notice.

title: Make primary planning navigation reachable without a long drawer scan
description: The drawer starts with a large explanatory hero and presents more than twenty destinations. At 1280 by 720 pixels, primary planning destinations and account tools require independent drawer scrolling. Naming mixes Todo, Tasks and Habitica tasks and Rewards.
expected_behavior: Expose a clear compact hierarchy for frequent planning and game destinations, make the active section apparent, and keep common capture and account navigation easy to find. Retain direct routes and a clearly separate Habitica cache entry.
context: The scope is shell navigation and naming. Existing Returning User Copy Compression explicitly excludes navigation redesign and remains a separate backlog item.

title: Bound companion collection rendering and clarify search results
description: The reviewed expanded Pets and Mounts state produces about 231507 pixels of desktop content and 490536 pixels on a phone. Search reduces the catalog but offers no aggregate result count or single empty-result recovery; separate group notices and unfiltered surplus inventory remain lengthy.
expected_behavior: Keep large expanded collections bounded and navigable, provide clear aggregate search feedback and a simple reset, and distinguish collection results from separate inventory-sale planning. Preserve explicit hatch, feed and sale previews.
context: PetsMountsPage renders matching pets and mounts inside each group and persists folds. The observed starting state includes saved expansion choices; no claim about a fresh profile default is made. Individual empty-group messages already exist.

title: Add direct discovery for equipment slots and owned items
description: Equipment shows loadout, optimizer, presets and repeated category grids before many owned items. The reviewed account has 291 items and an approximately 7526-pixel desktop page, with no item search or compact slot navigation.
expected_behavior: Provide a direct way to find an owned item or reach a slot without scanning the full page. Keep equipped identity, comparisons, optimizer choices and explicit equipment actions intact.
context: InventoryPage uses category expansion and best-in-category summaries, which should remain useful after discovery improves. No optimizer or Habitica equipment mutation change is requested.

title: Place required Daily schedule fields before the add action
description: Daily capture places Add Daily immediately after the title and before required repeat, interval, start-date and timezone fields. On phones the primary action appears before the information needed to submit a valid Daily.
expected_behavior: Present Daily capture as one ordered form with required schedule inputs preceding the primary review or add action. Preserve title-first Todo and Habit capture, explicit schedule semantics and required Habitica correspondence.
context: The current linked-daily-editor capture shows the same action ordering as the deployed /todo/dailies route. No schedule backfill, Cron or provider penalty change is authorized.

title: Offer understandable supported timezone choices for linked Dailies
description: Linked Daily creation asks for raw UTC or Etc/GMT identifiers with reversed offset signs. The recurring editor suggests Europe/Paris even when the selected linked schedule only accepts a supported fixed zone.
expected_behavior: Show understandable supported offset choices and context-specific labels, retaining exact normalized timezone identity in reviews. Unsupported DST and nonmidnight day-start behavior remains explicitly unavailable rather than silently converted.
context: TodoTaskPanel and TodoRecurringEditor have different supported linked and unlinked schedule constraints. Process Pending must preserve the linked-daily-schedules contract and fixed-offset sign semantics.

title: Shorten saved-list authoring and prioritize existing lists
description: Saved lists opens a complete filter editor before saved definitions and results. The current phone example is about 3387 pixels tall and exposes source, type, state, urgency, organization, mapping and fixed and relative date controls together.
expected_behavior: Make existing definitions and matching results easy to reach, with a compact common creation path and additional filters on demand. Preserve complete reviewed definitions, explicit date conflicts and unavailable-result safeguards.
context: TodoSavedListPanel already collapses exact saved filters in results; the authoring form remains fully expanded. Relative-date support is implemented locally and must be included in the design research.

title: Identify the exact invalid saved-list fields and preserve focus
description: Saved-list validation can return one broad paragraph listing date ordering, relative presets, timezone, search length, stage and source constraints. The paragraph does not identify the specific invalid field or associate the error with the affected control.
expected_behavior: Name the actual invalid constraint beside the affected field, expose the association to assistive technology, preserve entered values and move or link focus usefully. Retain rejection of conflicting dates and unsupported definitions.
context: TodoSavedListDraft.Build throws a generic aggregate instruction when query validity fails. TodoSavedListPanel renders the message as a top-level alert without field-level invalid state.

title: Make phone note capture reach the editor directly
description: The phone Notes view stacks source guidance, project and folder filters, library results and pagination before the editor. New note focuses the editor heading but leaves substantial preceding library and association controls on screen before the title and body.
expected_behavior: Provide a clear phone transition between finding notes and editing a note, with the title and writing area promptly reachable after New note. Preserve unsaved drafts, project and folder context, original receipt recovery and keyboard return paths.
context: The deployed New note interaction correctly moves focus to the editor heading; focus is not absent. Current local folder support adds further controls to the same stacked layout.

title: Open Projects on existing work and reveal management on demand
description: Projects places category selection, a new-project form and alias guidance before existing project records, the project task selector and linked Notes. The normal phone state spans roughly 3006 pixels before the page ends.
expected_behavior: Make existing projects and associated tasks and Notes the direct browsing path. Keep creation, optional organization and record management available through clear deliberate actions with the same reviews and retained identity rules.
context: TodoProjectsPage composes TodoOrganizationPanel before project task navigation. The request concerns entry hierarchy rather than changes to optional organization or project membership semantics.

title: Organize Settings around clear account and data-management sections
description: Settings begins with iPhone installation guidance before the page-level account heading and stacks session, appearance, integration, shared planning, three backup systems and destructive local clearing in one long page. The reviewed phone state is about 6467 pixels tall.
expected_behavior: Provide scannable section navigation and plain distinctions between browser data, private device sync and readable cloud Workspace data. Keep current connection state and likely next actions visible while preserving independent consent and destructive confirmation boundaries.
context: Existing Settings Danger Zone Confirmation covers destructive confirmation, not Settings information architecture. Returning User Copy Compression remains separate from account and data-management grouping.

title: Distinguish unchecked push capability from unsupported browsers
description: Before Check push setup runs, the push panel displays Browser capability unprepared and Permission unsupported together. No browser capability observation has established unsupported permission at that point.
expected_behavior: Use an explicit not-checked state until capability is observed, then distinguish available, installation-required, denied and unsupported outcomes. Permission prompts remain restricted to the explicit device action.
context: PushDeviceController initializes BrowserPushCapability with unprepared and unsupported. The issue is status presentation, not evidence of failed notification delivery.

title: Use named day controls for repeating push reminders
description: Weekly reminder setup asks for comma-separated weekday numbers from zero through six. Monthly setup similarly relies on a raw comma-separated list. Ordinary schedule selection requires knowledge of transport-oriented encodings.
expected_behavior: Offer named weekday choices and clear month-day selection with specific validation and a readable review. Preserve exact recurrence, timezone, DST, end-date, device consent and original-command behavior.
context: TaskPushReminderEditor uses text inputs for schedule-days and schedule-month-days. TodoRecurringEditor already provides named weekday checkboxes as a nearby interaction pattern.

title: Give repeated record controls contextual names and disclosure state
description: Task Complete and Details, gear Equip item, member Details and Settings Exclude controls repeat without record-specific accessible names. Member detail toggles also omit expanded-state and controlled-region associations; preset-name fields rely on placeholders.
expected_behavior: Keep short visible labels while exposing the affected record or sync section in accessible names, persistent input labels and disclosure state. Verify keyboard and screen-reader-oriented navigation without changing action authorization.
context: The current accessibility snapshots and Razor source expose repeated generic controls. Duplicate button text alone is treated as a navigation risk rather than a blanket compliance failure; the unnamed global menu remains a separate finding.

title: Keep disabled control text readable in built-in themes
description: Disabled buttons become very faint in Gryphy Light and remain dim in Obsidian Glow. Normal-looking disabled Daily schedule inputs and low-visibility action labels make editor readiness harder to understand.
expected_behavior: Use readable disabled foreground, border and surface tokens with a clear noninteractive appearance and relevant disabled reasons. Verify actual disabled controls in light and dark themes at normal and enlarged text.
context: app.css uses disabled tokens, including translucent foregrounds, and applies additional opacity to Notes buttons. The rendered matrix intentionally skips disabled text contrast, so the passing matrix does not qualify disabled readability. No WCAG text-contrast violation is asserted for inactive controls.

title: Keep selected native dates readable with enlarged text
description: At 360 pixels and 200-percent text, Today allocates about 105 pixels to a native date input with a 30.4-pixel font. The selected date disappears and only the calendar affordance remains, although the input retains a valid date value.
expected_behavior: Reflow the date and Today action so the selected civil date remains readable and editable at phone widths and enlarged text. Extend rendered checks to native input content visibility rather than relying only on outer control bounds.
context: todo-day-controls uses minmax(0, 1fr) beside an auto-width button, with min-width zero on the input. The affected fixture passes current geometry and text sampling because native input text is outside the text-node contrast inspection.

title: Prevent mid-word wrapping in equipment count summaries
description: At desktop width, the equipment item-count card gives the Hatching potions label a very narrow column beside the image and count. The label breaks into fragments such as Hatchi, ng, potio and ns in both reviewed built-in themes.
expected_behavior: Keep summary labels readable through appropriate wrapping or stacking without crowding counts and artwork. Verify narrow cards at desktop and phone widths, long labels and enlarged text.
context: InventoryPage RenderImageCountChip composes a fixed art slot, numeric count and text inside a nested summary grid. The symptom is visible at 1280 pixels, not only on phones.

title: Format private-sync timestamps without literal format suffixes
description: Settings cloud-sync rows display timestamps ending in a literal colon-g suffix, including the offset followed by :g. The presentation leaks the Razor formatting expression into visible account metadata.
expected_behavior: Render concise valid localized timestamps with a clear date and time context and no literal format markers. Preserve UTC storage and the original synchronization state.
context: SettingsPage renders status.UpdatedAtUtc.ToLocalTime() followed by :g outside a formatted expression. Existing component tests pass without asserting the final timestamp string.

title: Show explicit unset values in task-copy reviews
description: Task type-copy review prints empty values between labels for original planned date, deadline, review, parent, dependencies and target organization fields. Empty separators make absent data difficult to distinguish from an incomplete review.
expected_behavior: Render clear None or Not set values for absent fields and empty collections, with a scannable before-and-after summary. Retain exact source and target identities, copied and reset disclosures and original receipt recovery.
context: TaskTypeCopyReview interpolates nullable values and empty string.Join results directly. The current Daily copy screenshot shows labels followed only by separators.

title: Reconcile dashboard account freshness and refresh-history labels
description: Dashboard simultaneously shows Account data is up to date and Account not refreshed after successful sign-in. The snapshot freshness banner and refresh-history chip use different state sources without explaining the distinction.
expected_behavior: Present a coherent account-readiness summary, distinguishing data loaded during sign-in from later refresh attempts where relevant. Do not manufacture missing timestamps or claim a successful refresh from absent evidence.
context: DashboardPage derives the banner from UserFreshness and the Account chip from optional UserProfile DomainRefreshState. A missing domain entry currently renders not refreshed even while a fresh account snapshot is visible.
